event: After a format check on R01 (lines were valid but repeated the race facts in every sentence): cl2_commentary.py now joins numbers to their units, tells the model not to repeat the race facts after the first sentence, and adds a clock-based estimate of the remaining distance as a fact. The gating rule, the sentence check and the counting are unchanged. The R01 check output was deleted and is regenerated with the rest. Lock re-hashed.

Bug fix in cl2_commentary.py: the file pattern for results also matched the timestamp cache files (R01.pts.json), so the first full run stopped after R01. Pattern changed to R??.json; nothing else changed. All commentary output was deleted and is regenerated. Lock re-hashed.

Run 1 finished (commentary/, score.json). Checking the facts by eye showed two wrong inputs read by the model: R08 distance (1600 read, 1200 true) and R05 start time (17 s early). Run 1 is kept as it is. Run 2 (--v2) takes distance and start time from race_facts.json, and commentates only from the start to 3 s after the expected finish. The gating rule, the sentence check and the counting are unchanged. Lock re-hashed.
